title: "Speckit: Plan"
description: "Generate a milestone-based implementation plan from a spec, using .specify/plan-template.md."
---

Given a spec (from `/speckit.specify` or repository context), produce a milestone-based plan with estimated steps, priorities, and any required artifacts. Reference code locations, tests, and templates in the repo. Ask clarifying questions if scope or acceptance criteria are unclear.
